shortDescription: Create, restore, update or remove a snapshot.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: cpu_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable CPU (no reboot required).

options.name: cpu_hot_unplug
options.description: Hot-unplug capable CPU (no reboot required).

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter in which the volumes reside.

options.name: description
options.description: Human-readable description.

options.name: disc_scsi_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable SCSI drive (no reboot required).

options.name: disc_scsi_hot_unplug
options.description: Is capable of SCSI drive hot unplug (no reboot required). This works only for non-Windows virtual Machines.

options.name: disc_virtio_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable Virt-IO drive (no reboot required).

options.name: disc_virtio_hot_unplug
options.description: Hot-unplug capable Virt-IO drive (no reboot required). Not supported with Windows VMs.

options.name: licence_type
options.description: OS type of this snapshot

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the  resource.

options.name: nic_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable NIC (no reboot required).

options.name: nic_hot_unplug
options.description: Hot-unplug capable NIC (no reboot required).

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: ram_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable RAM (no reboot required).

options.name: ram_hot_unplug
options.description: Hot-unplug capable RAM (no reboot required).

options.name: snapshot
options.description: The ID or name of an existing snapshot.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: volume
options.description: The name or UUID of the volume.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
